"''Something about friendship?|Boba Fett and Fennec Shand, on Garfalaquox's statement|}} '''Garfalaquox''' was an [[Aqualish]] don who operated on [[Tatooine]]. After the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] took over the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] and [[Jabba's criminal empire|criminal empire]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]], Garfalaquox visited the palace to pay tribute to the new [[crime lord]]. The Aqualish brought Fett a chest of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] as a gift, addressing him and his partner, the [[Master Assassin]] [[Fennec Shand]], before departing. Garfalaquox appeared to accept Fett as the new [[Daimyo]], when in actuality he had joined the other dons in a deal with the [[Pyke Syndicate]] to help the [[Pyke]]s in their attempt to drive Fett from Mos Espa. While soldiers of the Aqualish family took part in the [[Battle of Mos Espa|battle]], Garfalaquox took refuge at the Pykes' [[Desert Survey Office|headquarters]] at the [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]] on Tatooine, alongside the other two family leaders and [[Mayor]] [[Mok Shaiz]] [[Mayor of Mos Espa|of Mos Espa]]. With Fett driving the Pykes out of the city, negotiations with the [[Pyke Boss|Pyke boss]] were interrupted when Shand carried out the [[Assassination of the Pyke Syndicate leaders|assassination]] of the conspirators, killing Garfalaquox first. ==Biography== ===Serving Jabba=== The [[Aqualish]] Garfalaquox was the leader of the [[Aqualish crime family|Aqualish family]] at the [[city]] of [[Mos Espa]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. Additionally, he served as a [[captain]] in the [[Jabba's criminal empire|criminal empire]] of the [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]]. In [[3 ABY]],{{OutlawsDate}} Garfalaquox was entrusted with a [[keycard]] to the Hutt Cartel vault at the [[Desilijic Complex]] in [[Mos Eisley]].''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]'' {{Gamemechanics|Star Wars Outlaws|canon=1}} However, the [[thief]] [[Kay Vess]] stole the keycard from a [[Hutt Barracks|barrack]] in the [[Great Chott salt flat]] region of Tatooine and later used it and other keycards to steal from the vault in 3 ABY. {{Endgame}} ===Tribute to the Daimyo=== {{Quote|We really need a protocol droid.|Boba Fett to Fennec Shand, as Garfalaquox departs|}} [[File:GarfalaquoxTribute-BoBFCh1.png|thumb|left|300px|Don Garfalaquox offers a container of credits as tribute to the new Daimyo.]] Following Jabba's [[death]]{{Film|VI}} in [[4 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' his [[majordomo]]{{Databank|bib-fortuna|Bib Fortuna}} [[Bib Fortuna]] laid claim to his empire, prompting Garfalaquox to pull his family out of the crime family, the leaders of the [[Strassi family]] and [[Tatooine Klatooinian family|Klatooinian family]] also doing so. Mos Espa was split between the families, the Aqualish controlling the [[Worker's District]]. Fortuna relied on uneasy alliances with Garfalaquox and the other two leaders,{{BOBF|Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa}} each of them attempting to overthrow the former majordomo to no avail. In [[9 ABY]], [[Boba Fett]], a famed [[bounty hunter]]{{Databank|boba-fett|Boba Fett}} who had chosen to move on from his former career, murdered Fortuna.{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 16: The Rescue}} Fett subsequently took control of Jabba's [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] as the new [[Daimyo]], attempting to [[Fett gotra|rebuild]] the remnants of his empire. After Fett took up residence in the palace, Garfalaquox was among those who visited to pay tribute to the new crime lord. The Aqualish entered the palace's throne room, addressing Fett and his accomplice, [[Master Assassin]] [[Fennec Shand]]. Presenting Fett with a chest of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], Garfalaquox made a statement about friendship before handing the credits to the [[8D-series smelter droid]] [[8D8]]. Garfalaquox bowed to Fett before turning and leaving the palace; however, neither Fett nor Shand had been able to fully understand the Aqualish's [[Aqualish (language)|language]], with Fett noting that they needed a [[protocol droid]]. ===Fett's proposal=== {{Quote|Master Garfalaquox finds this acceptable as well.|8D8 translates Garfalaquox's decision|}} [[File:GarfalaquoxAgrees-BoBFCh4.png|thumb|right|300px|Garfalaquox expresses intent to remain neutral in the war between Fett and the Pykes.]] With the [[Pyke Syndicate]] gathering troops in Mos Espa with the support of [[Mayor of Mos Espa|Mayor]] [[Mok Shaiz]], Fett gathered Garfalaquox and the other two family leaders for a banquet. After Shand summarized the power struggle following the fall of Jabba the Hutt, Fett warned the dons of the [[Pyke]]'s takeover on Tatooine. When the [[Unidentified Klatooinian boss|head]] of the [[Tatooine Klatooinian family|Klatooinian family]] suggested that they could make their own claim on the title of Daimyo by killing Fett, the were guests startled by a roar from Fett's [[Boba's rancor|rancor]], which resided beneath the throne room where the meeting was held. After Fett invited the leaders back to their seats. Garfalaquox questioned what the Daimyo was proposing, 8D8 translating his words. Fett thus proposed an alliance between the families against the Pyke Syndicate. The Daimyo's request did not set well, as the Klatooinian don protested against it, with agreement from [[Dokk Strassi]], the Strassi family leader. Fett therefore asked that the leaders instead remained neutral in his feud with the Pykes. The family leaders conversed with their associates, and Garfalaquox followed Strassi in agreeing with Fett's terms, the Klatooinian don doing so after. Toasting to their agreement, the leaders then departed to their speeders and left the palace. ===Fateful deal=== {{Quote|I thought we had a treaty.''"
"''So did I.|Din Djarin and Boba Fett, after Garfalaquox's men turned on the Mods|}} Garfalaquox's deal with Fett did not last long, as he and the other two family leaders had made a deal with the Pyke Syndicate, which required Tatooine to be hospitable for the syndicate's business. The leaders traveled to the Pykes' headquarters on Tatooine, the [[Desert Survey Office]] at the [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]], while the soldiers of the Mos Espa families and the Pykes prepared to overthrow Fett from his rule over the city. The families moved first in the resulting [[Battle of Mos Espa|attack]], with Garfalaquox's soldiers attacking Fett's biker gang, the [[Mods]]. The Mods struggled to hold off their attackers until they received assistance from Shand, killing a number of Aqualish family members the process. On top of that, Fett and his forces managed to drive the Pyke forces from Mos Espa, killing half of the Pykes in the battle. [[File:Death_of_Garfalaquox.png|thumb|left|300px|Garfalaquox was shot by Fennec Shand]] Back at the Desert Survey Office, Garfalaquox and the other family dons were present with Mok Shaiz and the Pyke Syndicate's [[Pyke Boss|boss]] on Tatooine. The Pyke boss informed the other four that his forces were withdrawing to Mos Eisley in preparation to leave the planet. Garfalaquox sat quietly as the other two dons confronted the boss, who argued that Tatooine was no longer hospitable for his syndicate. As the debate continued, though, gunshots sounded from outside. Garfalaquox was the first to draw a blaster, pulling his out while the Pyke boss called to his guards. The Pykes and the other family leaders soon followed Garfalaquox's lead, raising their blasters and checking the windows. Garfalaquox was the first to fall when a shot came in an struck him in the head, killing him. The attacker, Fennec Shand, proceeded to kill the room's six other occupants before leaving. ==Personality and traits== Garfalaquox possessed [[Color|white]] [[hair]], black [[eye]]s, and pale skin. The Aqualish spoke in the [[Aqualish (language)|Aqualish]] [[language]] of his [[species]]. When bowing to [[Lord]] Fett, he did so respectfully.Per the audio description for "[[Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land]]" available on [[Disney+]]. ==Equipment== The Aqualish wore a long set of red and tan [[robe]]s that featured a dark collar. The Aqualish also carried an [[SE-14r light repeating blaster]] on his person. ==Behind the scenes== Garfalaquox first appeared in "[[Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land]]," the first episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[December 29]], [[2021]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-december-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in December 2021}} The character was portrayed by [[Barry Lowin]] and identified in the episode's credits. Prior to the release of the episode, Garfalaquox was revealed in the series' trailer on [[November 1]], 2021.{{SWYouTube|rOJ1cw6mohw|The Book of Boba Fett | Official Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/official-trailer-the-book-of-boba-fett}} ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]'' {{Mo}} *{{BOBF|Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land}} {{1st}} *{{BOBF|Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm}} *{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|rOJ1cw6mohw|The Book of Boba Fett | Official Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/official-trailer-the-book-of-boba-fett}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|crABxPcIzCU|Reign | The Book of Boba Fett | Disney+|sw_url=video/reign-tv-spot-the-book-of-boba-fett}} *{{SWYouTube|Bi9GRafMz2E|The Return | The Book of Boba Fett | Disney+|sw_url=video/the-return-spot-the-book-of-boba-fett}} *{{SWYouTube|E7LMFmSIKbI|Authority | The Book of Boba Fett | Disney+|sw_url=video/authority-the-book-of-boba-fett}} *{{SWYouTube|Zb9Qa40LZyU|Return of a Legend | The Book of Boba Fett | Disney +|sw_url=video/return-of-a-legend-the-book-of-boba-fett}} *{{SWYouTube|s27xpz-qi-M|Throne | The Book of Boba Fett | Disney+}} *{{SWYouTube|CWLFEzyn9J8|Arrival | The Book of Boba Fett | Disney+}} *{{DisneyGallery|Disney Gallery: The Book of Boba Fett|The Book of Boba Fett}} *{{InsiderCite|217|A Certain Point of View}} {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Garfalaquox}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Garfalaquox |es=Garfalaquox |fr=Garfalaquox |ja=ガーファラクオクス |ka=გარფალაკვოქსი |nl=Garfalaquox |pl=Garfalaquox |pt=Garfalaquox }} [[Category:Aqualish]] [[Category:Crime lords]] [[Category:Desilijic servants]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Members of the Fett gotra]] [[Category:Pyke Syndicate members]] [[Category:Tatooinians]]
